# Imagine Your Craft (IYC)

A modern rebirth of the classic IYC 2012 mod
Developed by Stylobow

--- ## 📖 About Imagine Your Craft **Imagine Your Craft (IYC)** is a complete reimagining of the famous "Imagine Your Craft" mod originally released in 2012. Entirely rebuilt from scratch for modern Minecraft, this mod brings back the nostalgic soul of the classic experience while delivering exceptional performance, optimized code, and modernized designs. Whether you want to mine classic legendary materials, decorate your base with advanced furniture, or customize your character, IYC bridges the gap between 2012 nostalgia and modern gameplay. > 🌍 **Language Support:** The mod is fully available in both **English** and **French**. --- ## ✨ Key Features * **Classic Ores & Materials:** Rediscover iconic resources including Rubis, Saphir, Topaze, Adamantium, Lignite, Steel and Slate. * **Dynamic Decoration:** Enhance your builds with colored iron blocks, multicolored redstone lamps, and unique furniture (Chairs, Tables, Stools) available in all vanilla wood types. * **Advanced HUD:** A fully integrated, customizable HUD system to tailor your in-game interface. * **Cosmetic Customization:** Complete support for high-resolution HD Skins, custom Capes, and Hats to stand out on servers. --- ## 🚀 Installation Guide Make sure you are using the correct mod loader version for a seamless experience: 1. Download the latest version of the mod from the **Versions** tab. 2. Install **[NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/)** for Minecraft **1.21.1** (Recommended version: `21.1.216`). 3. Drop the downloaded `.jar` file into your `.minecraft/mods` folder. 4. Launch the game and enjoy! --- ## 💬 Community, Feedback & Bug Reports Your feedback is essential to keep improving the mod! If you encounter any bugs, visual glitches, or crashes: * **Discord:** Contact **Stylobow** directly on Discord (the fastest way to get support or share your feedback!). * **GitHub Issues:** Open a formal ticket on our issue tracker if you have a detailed log or crash report to provide. *When reporting a bug, please include your crash logs or screenshots to help resolve the issue as quickly as possible.* --- ## 🛠️ Credits * **Original Mod (2012):** Created by the original IYC Team. * **Remake & Code Modernization:** Rebuilt by Stylobow. * **Powered by:** NeoForge.

Thank you for playing Imagine Your Craft!
